test_title: PYST 44: SSC MTS - English (Held on: 25 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The judges applauded me for my ________ performance at the competition.
solution:
The correct answer is **outstanding.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate option to fill in the blank is** outstanding.**
 
• **Outstanding **means are **exceptionally good.**
 
• Thus the correct option would be** **outstanding.

​​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The other words given in the options are **usual** and **normal, **both are used for ordinary conditions.
 
• The word** large** is not related to the given sentence.
